👋 Welcome to CryptoWatch!

First, pick your timezone so alerts fire at the right time:

✅ Timezone set to UTC.

Default quiet hours: 22:00–7:00 (no alerts during sleep). You can change this later in Settings.

✅ Timezone set to America/New_York.

Default quiet hours: 22:00–7:00 (no alerts during sleep). You can change this later in Settings.
